policy: Program C community labels are run-local structural identifiers and crossings are structural observations under an exact projection.

allowed.statement: Under the named graph digest, calls-v1 profile digest, algorithm version, parameters, seed, and resource policy, node n1 was assigned run-local community c0.
allowed.reason: Binds a run-local label to exact structural inputs without asserting domain identity.

allowed.statement: Three retained CALLS occurrences cross between run-local communities c0 and c1 under this projection.
allowed.reason: Reports attributable structural occurrence accounting only.

allowed.statement: The community run is incomplete because the declared memory ceiling was reached; no labels or crossings are published.
allowed.reason: Preserves typed resource failure without semantic fallback.

prohibited.statement: Community c0 is the billing feature.
prohibited.reason: A run-local structural label cannot identify a product feature.

prohibited.statement: The crossing between c0 and c1 proves a business-domain boundary.
prohibited.reason: A structural crossing is not business-boundary evidence.

prohibited.statement: Community c1 belongs to the payments team.
prohibited.reason: The graph does not establish organizational ownership.

prohibited.statement: Community c2 is an independently deployable service.
prohibited.reason: Community output cannot establish deployment or service identity.

prohibited.statement: Matching labels across tested seeds prove this architecture is universally stable.
prohibited.reason: Bounded seeded observations do not establish universal stability or architecture meaning.

prohibited.statement: Successful clustering proves the input graph is complete and authenticated.
prohibited.reason: A community computation cannot upgrade graph custody or completeness.
